test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

This saree was bought by my son on the given occasion of my birthday.

options.text: My son bought this saree on the occasion of my birthday.
My son had bought this saree on the occasion of my birthday.
My son has bought this saree on the occasion of my birthday.
My son has been bought the saree on the occasion of my birthday.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is initially in passive voice: "This saree was bought by my son on the given occasion of my birthday." In passive voice, the object "this saree" comes before the verb, and the subject "my son" is introduced after the preposition "by."
 
• To convert the sentence to active voice, make "my son" the subject and place it at the beginning of the sentence.
 
• Additionally, change the verb from passive ("was bought") to the active voice verb ("bought").
 
• The correct active voice sentence is: "**My son bought this saree on the occasion of my birthday.**"

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"My son bought this saree on the occasion of my birthday."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "My son had bought this saree on the occasion of my birthday." – Incorrect tense (past perfect, which is not needed here).
 
• **Option 3:** "My son has bought this saree on the occasion of my birthday." – Incorrect tense (present perfect, which is not needed here).
 
• **Option 4:** "My son has been bought the saree on the occasion of my birthday." – This is still in passive voice.
